provenance.construction: Multi-band dense packing of distance-5 surface-code patches (arXiv:2511.06758 generalized): rows=12 bands, m=5 patches per even band, band pitch 6, patch pitch Px=12.
provenance.notes: Generalizes the multi-band dense packing of arXiv:2511.06758 beyond the two-band, three-patch configuration reconstructed in research/build_dense_surface.py. Literature novelty is unverified: the parameters were checked for domination and duplication against this board only. Builder submitted separately as PR #1608.
